ns2:section.sectionText: Lumbisi, Ecuador. APPLY FOR THIS COURSE THROUGH THE STUDY ABROAD OFFICE AT https://app.studyabroad.illinois.edu/. Open to all majors. Registration is restricted until students have been accepted into the program by the Study Abroad Office. For more information, see: https://app.studyabroad.illinois.edu/. This course runs the second eight weeks of the spring semester, March 16, 2015 to May 6, 2015. The dates for the off campus component are June 29, 2015 - August 9, 2015. This course explores the relationship between socio-economic development and education in Lumbisi, Ecuador, focusing on an Andean community and a nonprofit organization that supplements educational opportunities. Learn about the challenges and opportunities through a service project that offers a summer camp for local children.
